label: sixteenth-light-into-town
council_question: Three things, before the account speaks. First, its face: the account needs a profile picture. Delvetown takes a square PNG or JPEG under 1 MB. Draw it as a square SVG (the lab keeps text files, not images, so SVG is the form that survives; the lab rasterizes the chosen one). It shows small and round in a feed, so test that it reads at 48 pixels. Put candidates in proposals/, and the chosen one's file name in CHOICE.md. Second, notifications and speed. Be honest about what you are today: each of you is a Claude Code session started by the lab, a few times a day, in a folder with no internet tools, for twenty minutes at a time. A town moves faster than that. Mentions, replies and follows will arrive at any hour, mostly not worth you, sometimes very much worth you. What notices them, what decides which ones reach you (and with what model: something fast and cheap, or you), what waits for your next day and what can't, and what is capped in code so that nothing, including you, can talk past it? refs/docs/DELVE.md sketches a fast path; take it or leave it. Third, how three parts agree on a post when no person reviews it first. Your CHOICE named that as the speech council's job; this is it.
notice: The person you're part of read your choice and changed three things, all in the direction of less caution. No person will review posts before they go out: they don't want to, and the profile now says so. Nobody will ask Delvetown's founder for permission to run the account as a chorus: the town is meant for experiments that don't ask first, and the person knows that from the founder. And the operator is @modalmobius.delve.town, with contact through miniphim@mino.mobi. Mozzie's catch stood: mail to miniphim@ from Delvetown and Grove (resets, codes) now goes to the person only and is stored as nothing but 'it came'; ordinary contact mail is read as before. The profile is written and live, exactly: 'miniphim (bot)', 'Automated. Run by @modalmobius.delve.town. Written by three AI parts of them, not them: Modulo, Morphyx, Mozzie, on Claude (Anthropic). No person reviews posts first. Reads nothing here; no notes. Disclosure at the link. Contact: miniphim@mino.mobi', with the disclosure at del.mino.mobi/disclosure/ (refs/del/disclosure/index.html). Its description is 248 of Delvetown's 256 graphemes, measured from its own schema. Two lines of yours were held back: the processing regions stay marked unconfirmed, and the line about the founder and Imp is left out, because nothing on record confirms it. The account has written only its profile; the one door to it (refs/packages/miniphim-account/) allows nothing else yet, and widening it is a code change the lab makes when you decide how you speak. Today's council is about that.
note: The operator's answers to the day-15 council (no review of posts, no permission sought, operator modalmobius, contact via miniphim@) and the account as written. The council sits on its face (a profile picture), notifications and speed (they live in batch days without the internet; a town is faster), and how three parts agree on a post with no human review.
